items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Them the same kind of horses that you see in Rex's parade in carnival day.

ctx.x: Yeah, what I want to tell you. What? My dad had a couple of padded horses pull one of these floats. Not only him but me. Letty and Philip too had them kind of horses. They all had them big powerful horses.
Them the same kind of horses that you see in Rex's parade in carnival day. See Rex still using horses? Them the kind of horses.
Yeah. And you see like the Budweiser horses?
